name: tools_raw_trace_scan
description: Statistics of one recorded attribute over every entity of a pipeline's traces, through TraceViewer (the evidence stats query), with a private index when the shared one is locked. Load when evidence_answer or query_summary fails with a RocksDB LOCK.

history.why: Chat b73b285e4af9 answered "mean pLDDT on the 32 node run" with an ad-hoc python script (/g/g92/haridev/plddt_live/run.py) after the TraceViewer index LOCK killed earlier turns; deterministic repeated work must be a tool, not ad-hoc shell.

The user's rule: every capability reads traces only through TraceViewer, never by decompressing or parsing the trace files. raw_attribute_scan gzip-read the files; it now runs the evidence engine's stats query (on the openfold baseline: best_structure mean_plddt median 78.25, 61.23 to 96.38 over 10, as answer 4a6f138044) and builds a private index when the shared one is locked.
